keywords: 以太坊手续费全年低廉
退出使用合并队列的 EIP 合并

summary: nero_eth 宣布以太坊已运行 60M 区块 gas 上限，一年翻倍。evan_van_ness 指出 2025 年手续费一直很低。fradamt 的退出使用合并队列 EIP 合并。VitalikButerin 分享 Plinko PIR 教程，私密信息检索可让钱包查询链上数据而不暴露地址。

keywords_en: The gas limit doubles to 60M in a year
an EIP letting exits use the consolidation queue merged
Vitalik expects more targeted growth next year
summary_en: nero_eth said Ethereum now runs a 60M block gas limit, doubled in a year. evan_van_ness noted fees stayed cheap all of 2025. fradamt's EIP letting exits use the consolidation queue merged. VitalikButerin shared a Plinko PIR tutorial; private information retrieval lets wallets query chain data without revealing addresses.
